prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but there isn’t a single objectively “best” HVAC company for everyone. The right contractor depends on your exact location, whether it’s a one-time repair or a replacement, system brand/age, budget, and how quickly you need service.

Quick next step
- Tell me your ZIP code (or neighborhood) and whether this is an emergency repair or a planned job (repair vs full replacement). With that I can pull 3–5 highly rated local options and highlight who’s best for emergencies, warranty work, or cheapest repair.

Immediate guidance you can use now
- Check license & insurance: Verify the company’s Arizona Registrar of Contractors (ROC) license and that they carry liability insurance and workers’ comp.
- Read recent reviews: Look at Google, Yelp, Angi/HomeAdvisor and BBB for patterns (not just one 5-star).
- Ask these questions before you book:
  - Are you licensed in Arizona? What’s your ROC number?
  - Do you carry insurance and will you provide a certificate?
  - Do you charge a diagnosis/dispatch fee and is it waived if I proceed?
  - Do you offer written estimates and a written labor and parts warranty?
  - Have you worked on my brand/model before?
  - Do you require permits for replacements and will you pull them?
  - Are pricing/repair options flat-rate or time + materials?
- Compare 2–3 written estimates before authorizing major work.
- Red flags: very low price outliers, no written estimate or warranty, hard-sell upsells, technicians without identification.

If you want, give me your ZIP and whether it’s urgent and I’ll find top-rated, licensed HVAC contractors in Phoenix for your situation and summarize pros/cons for each.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
